ex.en: I use all kinds of software to study Chinese.
ex.zh: 我用各式各樣的軟體學中文。

ex.en: Pierre has a lot of pirated software on his computer.
ex.zh: 皮耶的電腦裡有很多盜版軟體。

ex.en: Sixty-four-bit software will not run on 32-bit architecture.
ex.zh: 64 位元的軟體沒辦法在 32 位元的架構上執行。

software.en: the programs that tell a computer what to do

ex.en: She spends too much time on social media.
ex.zh: 她花太多時間在社群媒體上。

ex.en: The news spread quickly on social media.
ex.zh: 這則消息在社群媒體上迅速傳開。

social media.en: websites and apps where people share messages, photos and videos

ex.en: The problem is that solar energy costs too much.
ex.zh: 問題是太陽能太貴了。

ex.en: We installed solar panels on the roof.
ex.zh: 我們在屋頂裝了太陽能板。

solar.en: using or relating to the energy of the sun

ex.en: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
ex.zh: 木星是太陽系最大的行星。

ex.en: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
ex.zh: 水星是我們太陽系中最小的行星。

ex.en: How many planets are there in the solar system?
ex.zh: 太陽系有幾顆行星？

solar.en: the sun and the planets that move around it

ex.en: I hope we'll see each other again sometime.
ex.zh: 希望我們改天還能再見面。

ex.en: Perhaps we could get a drink sometime.
ex.zh: 也許我們改天可以一起喝一杯。

ex.en: Write me sometime, OK?
ex.zh: 有空寫信給我，好嗎？

sometime.en: at a time that is not yet known or decided

ex.en: My older brother is a very enthusiastic soccer fan.
ex.zh: 我哥哥是非常狂熱的足球迷。

ex.en: The soccer game will be played, even if it rains.
ex.zh: 就算下雨，足球比賽也會照常進行。

ex.en: Soccer is the most popular of all sports.
ex.zh: 足球是所有運動中最受歡迎的。

soccer.en: a game in which two teams kick a ball and try to score goals

ex.en: I like soups with lots of vegetables.
ex.zh: 我喜歡有很多蔬菜的湯。

ex.en: You can't make good soup with cheap meat.
ex.zh: 便宜的肉做不出好湯。

ex.en: A good cook doesn't throw out yesterday's soup.
ex.zh: 好廚師不會把昨天的湯倒掉。

soup.en: a hot liquid food made by cooking meat or vegetables in water

ex.en: They wash their hands with soap.
ex.zh: 他們用肥皂洗手。

ex.en: We've run out of soap.
ex.zh: 肥皂用完了。

ex.en: This soap is infused with natural fragrances.
ex.zh: 這塊肥皂添加了天然香料。

soap.en: a substance you use with water to wash your body or clothes

ex.en: I like watching Korean soap operas.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡看韓劇。

ex.en: My mom watches a soap opera every evening.
ex.zh: 我媽每天晚上都看連續劇。

soap.en: a television series about the lives of a group of people, shown many times a week

ex.en: The boy went to bed with his socks on.
ex.zh: 男孩穿著襪子就上床睡覺了。

ex.en: You've got a big hole in your sock.
ex.zh: 你的襪子破了一個大洞。

ex.en: The heels of his socks had been worn out.
ex.zh: 他的襪子後跟磨破了。

sock.en: a soft piece of clothing worn on the foot inside a shoe

ex.en: I'd like to visit your country someday.
ex.zh: 我希望有一天能去你的國家看看。

ex.en: Hope we can do business again someday.
ex.zh: 希望有一天我們能再合作。

ex.en: I want to go to a foreign country someday.
ex.zh: 我將來想出國。

someday.en: at some time in the future

ex.en: The value of the yen has soared.
ex.zh: 日圓大幅升值。

ex.en: Travel agencies' profits soared.
ex.zh: 旅行社的利潤大幅攀升。

soar.en: to rise quickly to a high level

ex.en: The birds soar in the air.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在空中翱翔。

ex.en: An eagle soared high above the valley.
ex.zh: 一隻老鷹在山谷上空高高翱翔。

soar.en: to fly high in the air

sophisticate.zh: 見過世面的人、老練世故的人

ex.en: He likes to think of himself as a city sophisticate.
ex.zh: 他喜歡把自己想成見過世面的都市人。

ex.en: The restaurant attracts young sophisticates.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳吸引了許多時髦老練的年輕人。

sophisticate.en: a person who has a lot of experience and good taste

ex.en: I am the sole survivor.
ex.zh: 我是唯一的倖存者。

ex.en: That's my sole concern.
ex.zh: 那是我唯一在意的事。

ex.en: She is the sole owner of the company.
ex.zh: 她是這家公司唯一的老闆。

ex.en: There was some chewing gum on the sole of Tom's shoe.
ex.zh: 湯姆的鞋底黏了口香糖。

ex.en: The soles of these shoes are very thin.
ex.zh: 這雙鞋的鞋底很薄。

sole.en: the flat bottom part of a shoe or foot

ex.en: Victory and defeat aren't solely decided by the size of your army.
ex.zh: 勝敗不只取決於軍隊的規模。

ex.en: The decision was based solely on cost.
ex.zh: 這個決定完全是以成本為考量。

ex.en: You are solely responsible for your account password.
ex.zh: 帳號密碼由你個人全權負責。

solely.en: only and not involving anything else

ex.en: Puerto Rico is not a sovereign state.
ex.zh: 波多黎各不是一個主權國家。

ex.en: Every sovereign nation has the right to make its own laws.
ex.zh: 每個主權國家都有權制定自己的法律。

sovereign.en: having the power to rule itself without control from others

sovereign.zh: （金融）國家的、主權的（如主權債務、主權基金）

ex.en: Investors are worried about sovereign debt in Europe.
ex.zh: 投資人擔心歐洲的主權債務問題。

ex.en: Norway has one of the largest sovereign wealth funds.
ex.zh: 挪威擁有全球規模最大的主權基金之一。

sovereign.en: belonging to or issued by a national government

ex.en: He is shy and a bit socially awkward.
ex.zh: 他很害羞，在社交上有點笨拙。

ex.en: We only meet socially once a month.
ex.zh: 我們私下聚會一個月只有一次。

socially.en: in a way that relates to meeting and talking with other people

ex.en: The company aims to be socially responsible.
ex.zh: 這家公司致力於善盡社會責任。

ex.en: Smoking is less socially acceptable than before.
ex.zh: 抽菸在社會上已經不像以前那樣被接受。

socially.en: in a way that relates to society and how people live together

ex.en: Tom is a socialist.
ex.zh: 湯姆是個社會主義者。

ex.en: He has been a socialist all his life.
ex.zh: 他一輩子都是社會主義者。

socialist.en: a person who believes that wealth and power should be shared equally

ex.en: The Socialist Party only got 18% of the votes.
ex.zh: 社會黨只得到 18% 的選票。

ex.en: The country had a socialist government for decades.
ex.zh: 這個國家曾由社會主義政府執政數十年。

socialist.en: based on the belief that wealth and power should be shared equally

ex.en: Each nation has sovereignty over its own territory.
ex.zh: 每個國家對自己的領土擁有主權。

ex.en: The treaty respects the sovereignty of both countries.
ex.zh: 這項條約尊重兩國的主權。

sovereignty.en: the power of a country to rule itself

ex.en: How come you know so much about Japanese history?
ex.zh: 你怎麼對日本歷史知道得這麼多？

ex.en: I am happy to have so many good friends.
ex.zh: 我很高興有這麼多好朋友。

ex.en: It's a rainy day, so we can't play outside.
ex.zh: 今天下雨，所以我們不能去外面玩。

ex.en: The store was closed, so we went home.
ex.zh: 店關了，所以我們就回家了。

so.en: used to show that something is the result of what you just said

so.zh: （代替前面的內容）這樣、如此（I think so）

ex.en: "Is the meeting canceled?" "I think so."
ex.zh: 「會議取消了嗎？」「我想是吧。」

ex.en: I told you so!
ex.zh: 我早就跟你說了！

so.en: used instead of repeating something that has just been said

ex.en: Speak louder so that everyone can hear you.
ex.zh: 講大聲一點，讓大家都聽得到。

ex.en: I left early so that I wouldn't miss the bus.
ex.zh: 我提早出門，以免錯過公車。

so.en: used to show the purpose of an action

ex.en: School has started and I like it so far.
ex.zh: 開學了，到目前為止我都很喜歡。

ex.en: So far, we've received 50 orders.
ex.zh: 到目前為止，我們已經收到五十筆訂單。

ex.en: Take your time, or you may make some mistakes.
ex.zh: 慢慢來，不然你可能會出錯。

ex.en: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.
ex.zh: 電視確實也有一些缺點。

ex.en: Tatsuya has some friends who live in New York.
ex.zh: 達也有幾個朋友住在紐約。

some.en: an amount or number that is not exactly stated

some.zh: 一些人、一些東西；一部分

ex.en: Some of my coworkers work from home.
ex.zh: 我有些同事在家工作。

ex.en: I made cookies. Would you like some?
ex.zh: 我烤了餅乾，你要來一些嗎？

some.en: a part of a group or amount, but not all

ex.en: Mary got the nod from among some 500 applicants.
ex.zh: 瑪麗從大約五百名應徵者中脫穎而出。

ex.en: Some 200 guests attended the event.
ex.zh: 大約有兩百位賓客參加了這場活動。

some.en: used before a number to mean about

ex.en: For some reason I feel more alive at night.
ex.zh: 不知道為什麼，我晚上比較有精神。

ex.en: Some guy called for you earlier.
ex.zh: 剛剛有個人打電話找你。

some.en: used for a person or thing that is not known or named

ex.en: His absence gave birth to all sorts of rumors.
ex.zh: 他的缺席引發了各種謠言。

ex.en: All sorts of people live in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 東京住著各式各樣的人。

ex.en: What sort of coats are in fashion this year?
ex.zh: 今年流行哪一種外套？

sort.en: a group of things or people that share qualities

ex.en: Don't worry, we'll sort it out.
ex.zh: 別擔心，我們會解決的。

ex.en: I need to sort out my files.
ex.zh: 我需要整理一下我的檔案。

sort.en: to deal with a problem, or to put things in order

ex.en: Please sort the documents by date.
ex.zh: 請把文件依日期排序。

ex.en: The machine sorts letters automatically.
ex.zh: 這台機器會自動分類信件。

sort.en: to arrange things in groups or in order

ex.en: I'm sort of tired today.
ex.zh: 我今天有點累。

ex.en: It's sort of hard to explain.
ex.zh: 這有點難解釋。

sort.en: used to say that something is true in a way but not completely

ex.en: You will soon get used to speaking in public.
ex.zh: 你很快就會習慣在公開場合說話。

ex.en: You will soon get accustomed to your new school.
ex.zh: 你很快就會適應新學校。

ex.en: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
ex.zh: 期待很快收到你的回音。

soon.en: in a short time from now

ex.en: As soon as the door opened, they ran away.
ex.zh: 門一打開，他們就跑走了。

ex.en: Call me as soon as you arrive.
ex.zh: 你一到就打電話給我。

soon.en: at the moment when something happens, and not later

ex.en: Social conditions are going backward rather than forward.
ex.zh: 社會不是在進步，而是在退步。

ex.en: Social customs vary from country to country.
ex.zh: 各國的社會習俗都不同。

ex.en: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
ex.zh: 德國在 1880 年代採用了社會保障制度。

social.en: relating to people and how they live together

ex.en: Tom is a very social person.
ex.zh: Tom 是個很喜歡社交的人。

ex.en: I'm not very active on social media.
ex.zh: 我在社群媒體上不太活躍。

social.en: relating to meeting and spending time with other people

ex.en: A strange sound was heard from behind the door.
ex.zh: 門後傳來一陣奇怪的聲音。

ex.en: Can you turn the sound down?
ex.zh: 你可以把聲音調小嗎？

ex.en: It sounds like they're not going to leave.
ex.zh: 聽起來他們不打算走。

ex.en: I thought Tom sounded angry.
ex.zh: 我覺得湯姆聽起來很生氣。

ex.en: The piano was out of tune; it sounded very bad.
ex.zh: 鋼琴走音了，聽起來很難聽。

sound.en: to seem a certain way from what you hear or read

ex.en: She gave me some sound advice.
ex.zh: 她給了我一些中肯的建議。

ex.en: The company is financially sound.
ex.zh: 這家公司財務狀況健全。

sound.en: based on good judgment and likely to be right

ex.en: I sometimes hear my father singing in the bathroom.
ex.zh: 我有時會聽到爸爸在浴室裡唱歌。

ex.en: It is sometimes hard to tell right from wrong.
ex.zh: 有時候很難分辨是非。

ex.en: Tom and Mary sometimes put honey in their tea.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗有時會在茶裡加蜂蜜。

sometimes.en: on some occasions but not always

ex.en: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.
ex.zh: 尊重法律是我們社會的根基。

ex.en: The family is the fundamental unit of society.
ex.zh: 家庭是社會的基本單位。

ex.en: Magic plays an important part in primitive society.
ex.zh: 巫術在原始社會中扮演重要角色。

society.en: all the people living together in a country or area

ex.en: She is a member of the local history society.
ex.zh: 她是當地歷史協會的會員。

ex.en: The society holds a meeting every month.
ex.zh: 這個協會每個月開一次會。

society.en: an organized group of people with a shared interest

ex.en: My son can count up to a hundred now.
ex.zh: 我兒子現在能數到一百了。

ex.en: Thank you for the present you gave my son.
ex.zh: 謝謝你送我兒子禮物。

ex.en: Tom and Mary have three sons and a daughter.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗有三個兒子和一個女兒。

ex.en: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
ex.zh: 對不起，讓你久等了。

ex.en: Sorry, but I think you've got the wrong number.
ex.zh: 不好意思，你好像打錯電話了。

ex.en: I'm sorry, but I didn't catch what you said.
ex.zh: 不好意思，我沒聽清楚你說什麼。

sorry.en: feeling bad about something you have done

ex.en: I'm sorry to hear that your father passed away.
ex.zh: 聽到你父親過世的消息，我很難過。

ex.en: I'm sorry to hear you lost your job.
ex.zh: 聽到你失業了，我很遺憾。

sorry.en: feeling sad because of something bad that has happened

ex.en: I really feel sorry for him.
ex.zh: 我真的很同情他。

ex.en: Stop feeling sorry for yourself.
ex.zh: 別再自怨自艾了。

sorry.en: to feel sad for someone because of their bad situation

ex.en: I can't get that song out of my head.
ex.zh: 那首歌在我腦中揮之不去。

ex.en: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my youth.
ex.zh: 每次聽到這首歌，我都會想起年輕的時候。

ex.en: Every one of his songs was a hit.
ex.zh: 他的每一首歌都很紅。

song.en: a piece of music with words that you sing

ex.en: I felt somebody pat me on the shoulder.
ex.zh: 我感覺有人拍了拍我的肩膀。

ex.en: We're looking for somebody who has experience in customer service.
ex.zh: 我們正在找有客服經驗的人。

ex.en: Somebody is waiting for Tom in the hall.
ex.zh: 有人在大廳等湯姆。

somebody.en: a person who is not known or not named

ex.en: He wants to be somebody someday.
ex.zh: 他希望有一天能成為大人物。

ex.en: She thinks she's really somebody now.
ex.zh: 她覺得自己現在是個了不起的人物了。

ex.en: The north and south differ greatly from each other.
ex.zh: 南北差異很大。

ex.en: Many swallows will come soon from the south.
ex.zh: 許多燕子很快就會從南方飛來。

ex.en: Kaohsiung is in the south of Taiwan.
ex.zh: 高雄在台灣南部。

south.en: the direction on your right when you face the rising sun

ex.en: How much is a plane ticket to South Korea?
ex.zh: 去南韓的機票多少錢？

ex.en: The Zulu tribe in South Africa has its own language.
ex.zh: 南非的祖魯族有自己的語言。

south.en: in or toward the direction opposite to north

ex.en: We drove south for three hours.
ex.zh: 我們往南開了三個小時。

ex.en: Birds fly south in winter.
ex.zh: 鳥兒冬天會往南飛。

south.en: toward the direction opposite to north

ex.en: These problems will be solved in the near future.
ex.zh: 這些問題在不久的將來都會解決。

ex.en: This is the best method to solve that problem.
ex.zh: 這是解決那個問題的最好方法。

ex.en: He is good at solving complicated mathematical problems.
ex.zh: 他擅長解複雜的數學題。

solve.en: to find an answer to a problem or question

ex.en: "Haven't we met somewhere before?" asked the student.
ex.zh: 「我們以前是不是在哪裡見過？」那位學生問。

ex.en: There are too many people here. Let's go somewhere else.
ex.zh: 這裡人太多了，我們換個地方吧。

ex.en: I need to find somewhere to practice dancing.
ex.zh: 我得找個地方練舞。

somewhere.en: in or to a place that is not known or named

ex.en: They supplied the soldiers with enough food and water.
ex.zh: 他們為士兵提供了充足的食物和水。

ex.en: The soldier kept a sharp lookout in the darkness.
ex.zh: 這名士兵在黑暗中保持警戒。

ex.en: This soldier was awarded the Purple Heart.
ex.zh: 這名士兵獲頒紫心勳章。

soldier.en: a person who is a member of an army

ex.en: This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!
ex.zh: 這條毛巾又軟又蓬鬆，摸起來好舒服！

ex.en: She was a tall, thin girl with long, soft brown hair.
ex.zh: 她是個又高又瘦的女孩，留著一頭柔順的棕色長髮。

ex.en: This bed is too soft for me.
ex.zh: 這張床對我來說太軟了。

soft.en: pleasant to touch and not hard or rough

ex.en: She spoke in a soft voice.
ex.zh: 她輕聲說話。

ex.en: The restaurant has soft lighting.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的燈光很柔和。

soft.en: gentle and not loud or bright

ex.en: After taking a bath, I drank some soft drink.
ex.zh: 洗完澡後我喝了點汽水。

ex.en: Root beer is considered a classic American carbonated soft drink.
ex.zh: 麥根沙士被視為經典的美式碳酸飲料。

soft.en: a cold drink that has no alcohol in it

soft.zh: soft skills：軟實力（溝通、合作等能力）

ex.en: Employers value soft skills like communication.
ex.zh: 雇主重視像溝通這樣的軟實力。

ex.en: Teamwork is an important soft skill.
ex.zh: 團隊合作是重要的軟實力。

soft.en: personal abilities such as communicating and working well with others

ex.en: Tom, Mary, John and Alice all looked somewhat surprised.
ex.zh: 湯姆、瑪麗、約翰和愛麗絲看起來都有點驚訝。

ex.en: With the approach of Christmas, business improved somewhat.
ex.zh: 聖誕節快到了，生意稍微好轉。

ex.en: The rental should be somewhat close to where I work.
ex.zh: 租的房子要離我工作的地方近一點。

ex.en: I feel like somehow I've stopped thinking of translation as something enjoyable.
ex.zh: 不知怎麼地，我覺得翻譯好像已經不再是一件樂事了。

ex.en: The plush fur of the toy felt so soft and somehow soothing.
ex.zh: 那個玩具的絨毛摸起來很柔軟，不知怎麼地讓人覺得安心。

somehow.en: in a way that you do not understand or cannot explain

ex.en: We have to have fun somehow.
ex.zh: 我們總得想辦法找點樂子。

ex.en: We'll finish the project on time somehow.
ex.zh: 我們總會想辦法準時完成專案。

somehow.en: in some way, even if it is difficult

ex.en: Do you think animals have souls?
ex.zh: 你覺得動物有靈魂嗎？

ex.en: The eye is the window of the soul.
ex.zh: 眼睛是靈魂之窗。

soul.en: the part of a person that is believed to continue after death

ex.en: Since then he has put his soul into his work.
ex.zh: 從那時起，他就全心全意投入工作。

ex.en: He sings with a lot of soul.
ex.zh: 他唱歌很有感情。

soul.en: strong feeling and energy in what you do

ex.en: There wasn't a soul in the office.
ex.zh: 辦公室裡一個人也沒有。

ex.en: Promise you won't tell a soul.
ex.zh: 答應我別告訴任何人。

ex.en: Our restaurant is near the southern bus station.
ex.zh: 我們的餐廳在客運南站附近。

ex.en: Kaohsiung is a city in southern Taiwan.
ex.zh: 高雄是台灣南部的城市。

ex.en: The southern part of the island is warmer.
ex.zh: 島上的南部比較溫暖。

southern.en: in or from the south of a place

ex.zh: 一封友善的信平息了他的怒氣。

ex.en: The soldiers stood in silent solemnity during the ceremony.
ex.zh: 儀式中士兵們肅穆地靜立著。

ex.en: There was a note of solemnity in her voice.
ex.zh: 她的聲音帶著一絲嚴肅。

softening.zh: 使變柔軟（soften 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The sun was softening the butter on the table.
ex.zh: 太陽讓桌上的奶油慢慢變軟。

ex.en: Her voice was softening as she spoke to the child.
ex.zh: 她對孩子說話時，語氣漸漸變得溫柔。

ex.en: Engineers checked the soundness of the bridge.
ex.zh: 工程師檢查了橋的穩固程度。

ex.en: The soundness of her argument impressed everyone.
ex.zh: 她論點的完備讓每個人印象深刻。

ex.en: A warm southerly wind blew all day.
ex.zh: 一整天都吹著溫暖的南風。

ex.en: The boat sailed in a southerly direction.
ex.zh: 船朝南方航行。

ex.en: The sorrowful music made her cry.
ex.zh: 那悲傷的音樂讓她哭了。

ex.en: He gave a sorrowful smile and said goodbye.
ex.zh: 他帶著哀傷的微笑說了再見。

sorting.zh: 分類；整理（sort 的現在分詞）

ex.en: I'm sorting my clothes into two piles.
ex.zh: 我正把衣服分成兩堆。

ex.en: She spent the afternoon sorting old photos.
ex.zh: 她花了一個下午整理舊照片。

ex.en: As a southerner, he is used to warm winters.
ex.zh: 身為南方人，他習慣了溫暖的冬天。

ex.en: The northern visitors were surprised by the southerner's slow, friendly way of talking.
ex.zh: 北方來的訪客對那位南方人慢悠悠又親切的說話方式感到驚訝。

ex.en: She is a quick solver of math puzzles.
ex.zh: 她很擅長快速解數學謎題。

ex.en: The software includes a solver for linear equations.
ex.zh: 這套軟體內含線性方程式的求解程式。

ex.en: Kenting is near the southernmost tip of Taiwan.
ex.zh: 墾丁靠近台灣的最南端。

ex.en: Antarctica is the southernmost continent on Earth.
ex.zh: 南極洲是地球上最南邊的大陸。

ex.en: I felt muscle soreness in my legs after the long hike.
ex.zh: 長途健行後我的腿覺得肌肉痠痛。

ex.en: A warm bath can ease the soreness in your back.
ex.zh: 泡個熱水澡可以舒緩背部的痠痛。

ex.en: The chimney sweep had a sooty face.
ex.zh: 那位掃煙囪的人滿臉煤灰。

ex.en: Sooty smoke poured from the old factory.
ex.zh: 烏黑的煙從那間舊工廠冒出來。

ex.en: Farmers in dry areas often grow sorghum instead of rice.
ex.zh: 乾旱地區的農民常種高粱而不是稻米。

ex.en: Sorghum is used to make flour and also strong liquor.
ex.zh: 高粱可以用來製成麵粉，也能釀成烈酒。

ex.en: Soya milk is a popular drink for people who avoid dairy.
ex.zh: 豆漿是不喝乳製品的人常喝的飲料。

ex.en: The farmer grows soya on most of his land.
ex.zh: 那位農夫在大部分土地上種大豆。

ex.en: The bank must prove its solvency to the regulators.
ex.zh: 這家銀行必須向主管機關證明自己有償付能力。

ex.en: Rising debts put the firm's solvency at risk.
ex.zh: 不斷增加的債務讓公司的償付能力陷入危機。

ex.en: My grandmother has a soft spot for stray cats and feeds them every evening.
ex.zh: 我奶奶特別疼愛流浪貓，每天傍晚都會餵牠們。

ex.en: I have a soft spot for old movies from the nineties.
ex.zh: 我特別偏愛九〇年代的老電影。

ex.en: The teacher has a soft spot for students who ask a lot of questions.
ex.zh: 這位老師特別喜歡愛發問的學生。

ex.en: Chocolate is my soft spot, so I never keep any at home.
ex.zh: 巧克力是我的弱點，所以我家裡從不放。

ex.en: Praise is his soft spot, and salespeople use it to win him over.
ex.zh: 稱讚是他的軟肋，業務員就靠這點來討好他。

ex.en: Sooner or later, you will have to talk to him about it.
ex.zh: 你遲早得跟他談談這件事。

ex.en: If you keep skipping breakfast, sooner or later you'll feel tired all day.
ex.zh: 如果你一直不吃早餐，遲早會整天都很累。

ex.en: We all make mistakes sooner or later, so don't worry too much.
ex.zh: 我們每個人遲早都會犯錯，所以別太擔心。

ex.en: So far, the project has gone very smoothly.
ex.zh: 到目前為止，這個專案進行得很順利。

ex.en: I haven't received any reply from him so far.
ex.zh: 到現在我都還沒收到他的任何回覆。

ex.en: This is the best movie I've seen so far this year.
ex.zh: 這是我今年到目前為止看過最好看的電影。
